context_for_next_testing_agent: Assign User to Organization feature fully tested. Key findings: (1) POST /api/organizations/{org_id}/members/assign accepts {user_id, org_role} body and maps org_role to platform role (admin→Admin, manager→Manager, member→User). (2) DELETE /api/organizations/{org_id}/members/{user_id} removes user from org and resets to personal account. (3) Super Admin sees 'Assign to Organization' option for personal users and 'Remove from Organization' for business users. (4) Org Admin does NOT see Organization section in dropdown menu. (5) Assign dialog shows 3 organizations and 3 role options with platform role descriptions.
